data.street_address: Churchill Place, Canary Wharf, London, E14 5RB

description.text:
Ted's Grooming Rooms by Ted Baker offers gents the traditional barber shop luxury experience.

Ted's 12th Grooming Rooms has landed in Canary Wharf to keep things 'Trim & Proper' in East London.

No appointments are needed, reflecting their ability to be flexible and fit in nicely with the busy Canary Wharf gents.

Expect complimentary drinks for all customers, Ted's Master Barber's undivided attention and a relaxing, enjoyable top notch treatment.

Visit Ted's Grooming Room in Churchill Place and Cabot Place.

Walk in services and bookings available.

Note: Last walk in time is 30minutes before closing.

Location: Churchill Place

Ted's barbers offer traditional Turkish barbering services with London flair; from the closest shave out of Istanbul to the Full Ted treatment, all with an invigorating hot towel, massage, ear flaming and professional cut/ shave from the best barbers in town. You'll leave feeling relaxed, refreshed and looking your best and this Ted's Grooming Room has a special offering of an in-house barista coffee bar from The Good Yard coffeehouse who are already established in London city. Coffee will be available for sit in and take away to the ladies and gents of Canary Wharf.

Visit Ted's Grooming Room in Cabot Place and Churchill Place.

Walk in services and bookings available.

Note: Last walk in time is 30minutes before closing.

Location: Cabot Place
